evidence: p1/trust.py:24-74 real-time PowerShell Get-Acl DACL query: acl_protected (no inheritance) required (67-68), owner == current SID required (69-70), no Allow ACE outside {current user, S-1-5-18, S-1-5-32-544} (27,35-38,71-72)

all five entry points enforce it: p1/workflow.py:149 status(), 647+672 run(), 712 resume(), 629 approve_spec(), 495 verify_evidence(); export_report via _require_trust (737) + verify_evidence

probe t1 (Windows, real ACLs): default inherited ACL -> status BLOCKED / integrity_preflight FAILED / run BLOCKED / evidence NON_COMPLIANT / dispatched=0 / events 1->1 unchanged / persisted READY not re-sealed
probe t1 spy: ACL script contains only Get-Acl/GetAccessRules, no Set-Acl/icacls/grant verbs; home and db paths embedded literally

round4_target_findings.assessment: Mechanism is real, live on Windows, fail-closed and wired into every entry point. NOT judged FIXED because: (1) the trust premise 'Agent subprocesses must not share the Orchestrator OS identity' exists only in comments (trust.py:3-6) and is never enforced in code (no token/SID-difference check, no runas/LogonUser anywhere in p1/); a same-identity process can still append gate02_approved/reviewer runs; (2) the check is scoped to mode=='integration' (workflow.py:127-128) - probe t2 reproduces the Round-004 append-forgery vector inside offline_fixture (chain issues=[], run advances to stage 3+4); (3) real integration additionally gated by TRUSTED_INTEGRATION_EXECUTION_VERIFIED=False (executor.py:21,121-122); (4) 21bao production ACL, dedicated account and process identity are NOT_VERIFIED, so Windows real-environment R4-001 cannot be declared fully resolved.
round4_target_findings.minimal_fix: Enforce the premise: at integration start verify the executing process token SID differs from any Agent subprocess SID (or require a provisioned dedicated service account and validate it), and document/enforce that offline_fixture ledgers are never admissible evidence.

new_findings.title: 信任检查面仅覆盖 home 与 state.sqlite，未显式覆盖 WAL/SHM 伴生文件与父目录
new_findings.evidence: journal_mode=WAL creates state.sqlite-wal/-shm; validate_private_task_home checks exactly [home, home/state.sqlite]; probe t2 monkeypatch spy confirms inspected=['.', 'state.sqlite'], never_inspected includes logs/artifacts/snapshots/audit_evidence/.task.lock, parent not inspected. Protection of -wal/-shm relies on NTFS inheritance, which the same check requires to be disabled (acl_protected) - a freshly created WAL file under a protected parent inherits the parent DACL, so exploitability is low; a same-identity attacker is out of scope of this model by design.
new_findings.impact: Under unusual provisioning (e.g. WAL files pre-existing with different DACL before protection) the enforced surface could under-cover the actual ledger bytes.
new_findings.minimal_fix: When present, append home/'state.sqlite-wal' and home/'state.sqlite-shm' to the validated paths list.

new_findings.title: capture.json/timeout.json 截断元数据未绑定事件链，事后可无痕改写
new_findings.evidence: probe t6 defect case: after a healthy COMPLIANT run, rewriting logs/<run_id>.capture.json (and finally erasing it) leaves verify_evidence verdict COMPLIANT both before and after; run details bind only stdout/stderr keys, no capture key.
new_findings.impact: Truncation metadata is advisory evidence; an attacker with filesystem access can hide that output was truncated without detection. Does not by itself forge a gate, because the truncated stdout bytes remain hash-bound.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Hash capture/timeout metadata into finish_run details and verify it in audit_events/verify_evidence.

new_findings.title: R4-001 三项回归测试在 Windows 全部 skip，目标平台对 trust.py ACL 分支零覆盖
new_findings.evidence: batch12 XML: test_r4_001_private_boundary_checks_owner_and_mode / test_r4_001_untrusted_integration_state_is_blocked_without_dispatch / test_r4_001_private_integrated_state_allows_preflight_but_not_unverified_harness all 'SKIP: POSIX mode check runs only on POSIX'

new_findings.title: OS 账户隔离信任前提未被代码强制；同身份伪造向量在逻辑上仍成立，offline 模式实测仍可追加伪造事件
new_findings.evidence: grep across p1/ docs/ prompts/ README.md finds no runas/LogonUser/impersonation/token-comparison/secondary-logon mechanism; trust.py itself documents that a same-identity privileged process is inside the TCB; probe t2: offline task with direct Store._event('gate02_approved') + task-row rewrite -> audit_events issues=[], run advances to stage 3+4 with worktree created
new_findings.impact: If 21bao deploys Agent and Orchestrator under one account with DB access, R4-001's protection does not apply; acceptance of the OS-isolation model requires an enforced, verifiable provisioning contract, not a comment.
new_findings.minimal_fix: Integration-mode startup check: spawn a probe subprocess and require its token SID to differ from the orchestrator's, or bind the ledger to a dedicated service account whose membership is verified; mark offline ledgers permanently non-evidentiary.
